gaps.cause: missing fund column; missing lines (nonoperating receipts recorded as revenue)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 (Governmental Funds, modified cash) Total Receipts 420,693.67 = General 306,006.45 + Street 92,849.44 + Keno 17,377.34 + PCI 4,460.44. Detail revenue (595,101) = General Fund departments schedule pp10-11 receipts 306,007 (cells; printed total 306,006) + the schedule's NONOPERATING RECEIPTS printed below its total (p11: TIF receipts 49,130 + 171,638, Donations 20,010 + 45,379 + 413 + 41, Interest income 1,809 + 27 + 617 + 8 + 22 = 289,094; detail 66-76). (1) Missing fund columns: Street, Keno and PCI print receipts only on the statement (the p9 budget schedule prints revenues for all funds combined): Street Property taxes 18,396.54, Motor vehicle 1,888.50, Other (taxes) 1,454.17, Intergovernmental 70,675.23, Other 435.00 = 92,849.44; Keno proceeds 17,377.34; PCI Other 4,460.44; added = 114,687.22. (2) The statement prints TIF receipts 220,768.44, Donations 65,843.29 and Interest income 3,067.29 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not in Total Receipts; the 11 detail lines are moved to section other financing (removed and re-added with the same fund/department/amount), plus the Keno column's Interest income 584.15 (p4 other financing) which no detail line had. Check: 595,101 + 114,687.22 - 289,094 = 420,694.22 vs 420,693.67 (0.55 = whole-dollar rounding of the departments schedule). NOTE for the apply step: the statement has two receipt lines labelled 'Other' (taxes 9,795.43 and other 119,443.19); the added Street 'Other' 435.00 and PCI 'Other' 4,460.44 are non-tax rows (category other), the Street 'Other' 1,454.17 is the tax row (category taxes).

gaps.cause: missing lines (interest expense recorded as expenditure)
gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Total Disbursements 659,358.55 = General 395,941.84 + Street 189,643.19 + Keno 66,705.11 + PCI 7,068.41. Detail expenditure 794,395 = departments schedule pp10-11 cells 530,979 (printed total 530,976) + budget schedule p9 Street 189,643 + Keno 66,705 + PCI 7,068. The departments schedule counts Debt Service Interest 135,035 (TIF Projects, p11; detail 63) inside Total Disbursements, while the statement prints it as 'Interest expense (135,034.52)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (General column 395,941.84 = 530,976 - 135,035 + rounding). Fix: move detail 63 to section other financing (removed, re-added as -135,035). Check: 794,395 - 135,035 = 659,360 vs 659,358.55 (1.45 = whole-dollar rounding).
